sn45.172:1.5: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave, catunnaṃ yogānaṃ abhiññāya …pe… pariññāya …pe… parikkhayāya …pe… pahānāya ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo. katamo ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti …pe… sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti. vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ. imesaṃ kho bhikkhave, catunnaṃ yogānaṃ abhiññāya …pe… pariññāya …pe… parikkhayāya …pe… pahānāya ayaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabboti.
